tagline: A classic AI challenge. Your next contest.
provenance: Built on Ants · Google AI Challenge 2011
story: Ants was the game of the 2011 Google AI Challenge, run by the University of Waterloo Computer Science Club: fog, food, and the race to raze a rival's hills, every colony moving at once.
TinyBrains reimplements those rules for trained neural networks. The game design and the maze and cell generators are the Ants creators'; the weight classes, the ratings and the arena are ours.

The challenge has changed with them. In 2011 you wrote the bot; here you train a network and write an adapter, and what you submit is measured into a weight class. The contest is not who can build the strongest player, but who can pack the strongest play into the fewest bytes.
